newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst 9-month gp pre-tax 5.66 bln - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst 9-month gp pre-tax 5.66 bln - analysts.

text.p: Analysts attending a presentation of Hoechst AG's nine-month results said on Wednesday the company told them group pre-tax profit including gains was 5.66 billion marks.
They said Hoechst will also report group sales of 38.41 billion marks and that group net profit was 3.05 billion marks during the first nine months of the year.
The chemical giant reported last year that nine month group pre-tax profit was 3.43 billion marks and that group sales were 39.14 billion marks.
Hoechst was due to hold a news conference at 0900 GMT.
